# EXACT versions from the pod image runpod/pytorch:1.0.2-cu1281-torch280-ubuntu2404.
# Passed via -c to EVERY pip install so pip can NEVER move the CUDA stack.
# numpy is 2.1.2 here, NOT the Mac's 1.26.4 — torch 2.8 is built against numpy 2 and
# downgrading would risk breaking it. The anchor rule is per-environment.
torch==2.8.0
torchvision==0.23.0
torchaudio==2.8.0
numpy==2.1.2
